clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: An invitation is separate from the later synthetic meeting.

clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Timely signal routing and deliberate investigation remain explicit.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The 23 January meeting showed false CEO/CFO presence and a request for several million Singapore dollars. Purported external participants appeared in silent loops.
